question: What would the annual interest accrued on a deposit of ₹3,500 in a bank that pays a 17% per annum rate of simple interest be?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Calculate **17% of ₹3,500** directly for one year.

Break down 17% into 10% + 5% + 2%.

10% of 3500 = 350

5% of 3500 = 175

2% of 3500 = 70

Total Interest = 350 + 175 + 70 = 595

**∴ The correct answer is ₹595.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Principal (P)** = ₹3,500

**Rate of Interest (R)** = 17% per annum

**Time (T)** = 1 year (Annual interest)

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/65abe872d593d6a3478845fc5d7bc1780b1d977d97ba0bf51cc8509dffebf114.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ SI = (3500 × 17 × 1) ÷ 100

⇒ SI = 35 × 17

⇒ SI = 35 × (10 + 7)

⇒ SI = 350 + 245

⇒ SI = 595

**∴ The correct answer is ₹595.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest Components

Simple interest is calculated only on the **Principal** amount. The formula is SI = (P × R × T) / 100, where P is Principal, R is Rate, and T is Time in years.

Total Amount Formula

The total **Amount (A)** received after the time period is the sum of the Principal and the Interest: A = P + SI.

Rate and Time Relationship

If the time is given in months, divide by 12 to convert to years. If given in days, divide by 365. The **Rate** must always correspond to the time unit used.
